cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Stay until the tea cools. You always rush goodbye. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then I wasn't really waiting for the tea.

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A commands a farewell tea break but trades the service routine for a less rushed goodbye to keep B there.
confusable: Generic delay lacks the return to the original tea excuse with a changed emotional meaning.
comparison: The second alternative treats return of a key as a test of continued welcome, rather than a timed drink.
seedUse: The cooling-tea seed supplies a finite excuse; S02 leadership is made contingent on B agreeing to remain.
